subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: When a draft round resumes or is abandoned, the system shall update the same selected-host PR and branch under a remote-head lease, retaining round and abandonment semantics.
fit_criterion: Round restores exact working bytes and same PR; successful abandonment requires affirmative automatic head-branch-deletion policy, the required reason Learning, and the existing human review/abandon transition; false, missing, malformed, or inaccessible policy observations cause zero reason-Learning, branch, or PR mutation; moved remote head refuses.
